The words of a handler, a case for each: a text written with the word any
old way, that text as it is laid out, the word written wrongly, and where
and why the reader refuses that. `WRITE_WORDS=1` on the test that reads
this writes what is laid out and what is refused, to be read before it is
kept.

=== handler.at
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        at:   "mon 02:00 Europe/Zagreb"
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    at: "mon 02:00 Europe/Zagreb"
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        at: 02:00
        do: noop
--- refused 4:13
`02:00` says no zone: write the zone the time is in after it, as `02:00 Europe/Zagreb` or `02:00 UTC`

=== handler.call
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        call: other
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    call: other
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        call: [x]
--- refused 5:15
`call` must be text, found a list

=== handler.debounce
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        debounce: 30s
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    debounce: 30s
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        debounce: soon
        do: noop
--- refused 5:19
`debounce`: `soon` is not a duration; write it like `30s` or `1h30m`

=== handler.do
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        do: nothing.like.it
--- refused 3:5
there is no action called `nothing.like.it`

=== handler.event
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: Not A Topic
        do: noop
--- refused 3:5
`Not A Topic` is not a topic pattern; use dotted words where `*` matches one word and `**` any number, like `board.item.*`

=== handler.every
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        every: 1m
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    every: 1m
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        every: often
        do: noop
--- refused 4:16
`every`: `often` is not a duration; write it like `30s` or `1h30m`

=== handler.for
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        for: {id: a}
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    for: { id: a }
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        for: [a]
        do: noop
--- refused 5:14
`for` must be a mapping from a field of the event's data to the value it must have, such as `{ id: "${params.item}" }`; found a list

=== handler.outside
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        outside: true
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    outside: true
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        outside: maybe
        do: noop
--- refused 5:18
`outside` must be true or false

=== handler.poll
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        poll:
            every: 1m
            do: noop
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    poll:
      every: 1m
      do: noop
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        poll: 3
        do: noop
--- refused 4:15
`poll` must be a mapping, found a number

=== handler.scope
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        scope: own
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    scope: own
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        scope: everyone
        do: noop
--- refused 5:16
unknown scope `everyone`; expected project, fleet, own or target

=== handler.steps
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        steps:
            s: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    steps:
      s: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        steps: 3
--- refused 5:16
`steps` must be a mapping of step name to step

=== handler.turn
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        turn: "${ event.data.row }"
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    turn: "${event.data.row}"
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        turn: [a]
        do: noop
--- refused 5:15
`turn` must be text, found a list

=== handler.when
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        when: ${ event.data.n > 0 }
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    when: ${ event.data.n > 0 }
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        when: ${ 1 + }
        do: noop
--- refused 5:15
`when`: the expression ends too soon

=== handler.with
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        do: log
        with: {message: hi}
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    event: w.poke
    do: log
    with: { message: hi }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        event: w.poke
        do: noop
        with: [a]
--- refused 6:15
`with` must be a mapping, found a list
